description: Puntos de Recarga VE is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. Electric vehicle charging points. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. The portal shows the English title as "EV Recharge Points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. Its keywords include vehículos, eléctricos, recarga. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.zaragoza.es/sede/portal/aviso-legal#condiciones). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
